activity.notes: Dacke led the Småland peasant rebellion against Gustav Vasa. ATLAS does not create a fictitious state called 'Smolandia'; it records the insurgent political community on Dacke's own side.

sources.title: Nils Dacke — Svenskt biografiskt lexikon, Riksarkivet
sources.citation_text: The Swedish National Archives' biographical lexicon identifies Nils Dacke as the leader of the Småland peasant uprising against Gustav Vasa in 1542–1543.
